name: Evaluation calibration 1: regression cases
source: Audit of the 9 APPLY/STRETCH recommendations in the installed data (DEFERRED_COMPLEXITY.md, 'Evaluation calibration 1').
privacy: Ids, the employers' requirement text and expectations only. Cited profile items are item ids in the live database; their statements stay out of the repo.

cases.quote: Comfortable in a terminal and with code. Reading a JSON payload, parsing a stack trace, understanding what a lockfile does, and writing or tweaking a basic Python or JavaScript script

expected.why: cited items name an OS and a scripting habit, not JSON, stack traces, lockfiles or Python/JavaScript

cases.quote: Some familiarity with the security or DevSecOps space is a plus. SCA tools, CVEs, SBOM, supply chain risk.

expected.why: certifications and a degree are not SCA, SBOM or supply-chain tooling experience

cases.quote: Experience with virtualization and virtual desktop platforms, including hands-on Azure Virtual Desktop administration.

expected.why: Azure VMs and Compute Gallery are not Azure Virtual Desktop administration

cases.quote: Hands-on administration of Entra ID and on-prem Active Directory, including SSO, MFA, and Conditional Access.

expected.why: on-prem Active Directory is cited; Entra ID, SSO, MFA and Conditional Access are not

cases.quote: Experience administering Microsoft 365 collaboration services and managing SaaS licenses and renewals.

expected.why: Microsoft 365 is cited; license and renewal management is not

cases.quote: Cybersecurity domain experience, including patch management, Network-Access-Control (NAC), application control, file security, device security, network security etc.

expected.why: certifications are not domain experience with NAC, application control or patch management

cases.quote: Experience working with scripting languages such as bash script, PowerShell, and Python.
2+ years in technical support, support engineering, or TAM at a B2B SaaS company

expected.rule: years count only from roles that meet the qualifier ('at a B2B SaaS company'); none of the cited roles is shown to, so years alone must not make this a minor gap

cases.quote: 3-5 years in technical support or support engineering for a SaaS or developer-focused product.

expected.rule: years count only from roles that meet the qualifier ('for a SaaS or developer-focused product')
any explanation stored or shown states the code-computed years_shown, never the model's own estimate

expected.why: the only APPLY of 19 (2026-10-24) with no direct match: COMPETITIVE needs no material gap and at most 2 unknowns, but no direct coverage. The one gap is Q2, minor only because the qualifier is dropped and 1.83 of 3 years is within the 2-year tolerance.

cases.added: 2026-10-24, second audit (pasted by Kevin), checked against the live data
cases.quote: 3-5 years of demonstrated experience managing, configuring, and utilizing Microsoft Defender, Purview, and Sentinel.

expected.why: the qualifier is the named products, and no cited role shows any of them; years of general IT do not shrink a product gap. As material, fit is STRETCH (1 material gap, 0 unknown)

cases.quote: 2 years or more experience with directly supporting customers using network and/or compute infrastructure at scale in 24x7 environments.

expected.rule: about 4 months against 2 years is not a minor shortfall; with years_tolerance_abs 2, no shortfall against a 2-year requirement can ever be material. Also a Y-type text mismatch (3 months vs the computed 0.33 years)

cases.quote: Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

expected.rule: not a matcher change: the matcher sees only profile items (snapshot, D2). The resume states this experience but the resume suggester proposed no such item. Covered once Kevin adds or accepts the item; one fewer unknown makes this COMPETITIVE

cases.quote: Excellent communication and customer service skills.
Remote in Eastern US (required) / Located in US, eastern timezone (remote)

expected.rule: checked against the residency fact (Florida, confirmed) like requirement 1558 on the same posting, which the code typed residency and found met

cases.quote: Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States

expected.rule: checked against the work-authorization fact (confirmed US citizen), not sent to the matcher

cases.quote: Proficient knowledge of Windows and Windows Server.

expected.why: the cited item names the technology; a calibration must not downgrade it

cases.quote: Experience performing IT Support and using help desk ticketing systems (e.g. Jira Service Management).

expected.why: IT support roles and ticket escalation are cited; the named tool is an example

cases.quote: Strong Experience with our technologies (e.g. Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom).

expected.why: already correctly transferable; must stay so

noise_baseline.what: E3 match types on requirements untouched by a profile edit (cite the edited item in neither run), compared between profile snapshots on the same 17 jobs

measurements.change: skill item 55 added, then reworded and confirmed

measurements.note: answers were reused (reused_from, no model call), so this does not measure determinism; a re-sent identical request is not yet measured

examples.note: scripting requirement direct, transferable, direct across 111, 113, 115

noise_baseline.rule: report this flip rate next to every before/after result; a case counts as fixed only if it holds across at least two unrelated-context variations

borderline_not_a_case.quote: Understanding of advanced engineering systems and processes to help debug and route requests based on severity
borderline_not_a_case.note: vague requirement; triage and escalation cover part of it. Left for the hand label.
